title: Outdoor group in front of ornate multi-gabled building
objects_and_counts: Eleven people are visible standing in a single row across the central foreground; all are full or near-full body views and none are cropped at the image edges.
Multiple people wear lanyards with vertical badge holders; the exact count of lanyards visible is nine when inspected on the individuals but some badges are partly obscured.
One large multi-gabled building occupies most of the mid- and background; no interior signage or room numbers are visible on the building.
Two palm trees are visible: one roughly centered behind the group and another at the right edge of the frame (the second is partly cropped by the image edge).
Paved open plaza or courtyard surfacing is visible in the foreground covering the full width of the image; no fixed indoor equipment is visible.
spatial_relations: The eleven people form a roughly single-file horizontal line in the image foreground; they are standing shoulder-to-shoulder with small gaps between most individuals.

Directly behind the group and occupying most of the background is a large white building with decorative multi-tiered roofs; the building runs diagonally from left rear toward the right rear of the image.
A tall palm tree is almost centered behind the group and in front of the building façade; another palm is on the far right edge behind a tree.
Green hedges and low shrubbery run along the left background between the paved foreground and the building.
The paved courtyard extends from the foreground up to the base of the building with no visible barriers between the people and the building.
colours_and_materials: The building façade is primarily white with ornate trim and roof edges in red and terracotta tones; the main roof tiles appear dark blue or dark grey with lighter orange or red ridge accents.
The palm trees and other vegetation are green; hedges at left are medium to dark green.
The foreground paving is light grey or beige, appearing as concrete or stone tiles.
People's clothing includes a noticeable bright yellow polo on one individual near the center; other clothing includes white, navy blue and black shirts and dark trousers or shorts.
uncertainties: No room name, room number, or internal signage is legible in the image, so the precise location within any campus or facility is unknown from the image.
Logos or small printed text on clothing and badges are not legible at this resolution; attempts to read brand names, team names or badge text did not yield reliable text to transcribe.
Some badge holders and lanyards are partially obscured by hands or body position, so the count of visible badges (nine) may be an undercount.
The material identification of the paving and roof tiles is based on visual appearance only and is not certain.
